schema.text: Do you feel less secure from crime or harassment where there are few people around (isolated or deserted areas)?

ar.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: هل يقلّ شعورك بالأمان من الجرائم أو التحرش في الأماكن التي يقلّ فيها الناس (المناطق المعزولة أو المهجورة)؟

de.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Fühlen Sie sich dort, wo wenige Menschen sind (abgelegene oder menschenleere Orte), weniger sicher vor Kriminalität oder Belästigung?

en.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Do you feel less secure from crime or harassment where there are few people around (isolated or deserted areas)?

fa.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: آیا در جاهایی که آدم کمی هست (مناطق خلوت یا متروک) در برابر جرم یا آزار احساس امنیت کمتری می‌کنید؟

fr.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Vous sentez-vous moins à l’abri de la criminalité ou du harcèlement là où il y a peu de monde (zones isolées ou désertes) ?

hu.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Kevésbé érzi magát biztonságban a bűncselekményekkel vagy a zaklatással szemben ott, ahol kevés ember van (elhagyatott vagy néptelen helyeken)?

it.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Ti senti meno al sicuro da reati o molestie dove c’è poca gente (zone isolate o deserte)?

tr.#Do you feel less secure from crime or h: Etrafta az insan olan yerlerde (ıssız veya tenha alanlarda) kendinizi suça veya tacize karşı daha az güvende hissediyor musunuz?
